name: License Text Generator
summary: Fill MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, ISC, Unlicense, or GPLv3 notice text with your year and name.
description: Pick a common open-source license template, set copyright year and holder (and project name for the GPLv3 notice), then copy a LICENSE file. Not legal advice — review the full license before you ship.

faqs.question: Is this legal advice?
faqs.answer: No. Templates help you draft a LICENSE file. Choose a license that fits your project and read it carefully.

faqs.question: Why is GPLv3 only a notice?
faqs.answer: The full GPLv3 is long. The tool generates the common short copyright notice; link to gnu.org for the complete text.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Text is generated in your browser.
